summary: Verified the inventory cache-staleness regression fix (src/cache.ts + src/api.ts). Logged in as Pro account (mechanicltz@gmail.com), confirmed existing inventory loaded (2 items: Test2, Test Drill). PRIMARY TEST 1 (no search active): created 'ZZ_Test_NoSearch' via FAB → Add Item; new item appeared immediately in inventory list (cards 2 → 3) without manual refresh. PRIMARY TEST 2 (regression — search active): typed 'ZZSEARCH' into search-input, created 'ZZSEARCH Wrench'; on return to Inventory the search filter was still active AND the freshly-created item appeared immediately in the filtered list (1 matching card visible). EDIT TEST: edited ZZ_Test_NoSearch → renamed to ZZ_Test_Renamed and saved; new name appeared immediately on the list, old name was gone. REFRESH TEST: switching tabs (Home → Inventory) preserved data, no blank state. CLEANUP: deleted both ZZ test tools via direct API (200 OK); Pro account is back to its original 2-item state. The clearCachedByPrefix() invalidation of api:/tools, api:/stats, api:/aggregate is working correctly — both bare-list and ?search=... cached variants are busted on mutations.
critical_code_review_comments: clearCachedByPrefix() implementation in src/cache.ts:98-108 correctly iterates both memory and meta maps and deduplicates matches. Looks solid.

invalidateRelatedCaches() in src/api.ts:414-437 prefix-clears /<seg>, /stats, /aggregate AND drops in-flight GET dedupe entries under the same prefix — prevents the next read from awaiting a stale dedup promise. Correct fix.
inventory.tsx:613 effect debounces search by 250ms and calls load() — combined with cache.ts:apiCacheKey(`/tools?search=...`) this works because the path string used as the cache key is identical.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 temporary tools (ZZ_Test_NoSearch later renamed to ZZ_Test_Renamed, and ZZSEARCH Wrench) on the Pro account during testing; BOTH have been deleted via DELETE /api/tools/{id} at the end. Account left in original state (2 items: Test2, Test Drill).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pro account (mechanicltz@gmail.com / Blue321!) currently has 2 baseline tools: Test2, Test Drill. Use this account for any tool-creation tests; ryan@ryan.com is at the free-tier 15-item limit (402). The cache regression fix is verified working — creating a tool while a search filter is active surfaces the new tool immediately in the filtered list. testIDs of interest: add-item-fab → add-choose-item modal → /tool/edit screen (acc-name, name-input, acc-pricing, cost-input, acc-purchase, purchase-input, save-tool-bottom-btn).
